thread:
maya: Quick sync — I'm opening a tiny PR to simplify the prefetch + batching examples in the inference-opt guide. It collapses the two long examples into one concise walkthrough and adds a JS SDK snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :dart:
ben: Nice. Can you also surface the common gotcha about `max_concurrent_requests` + `batch_size`? Lots of people hit starved batches if they set both too low.
arjun: Also add a note about `kv_prefetch=True` requiring the model variant to support prefetch manifest. We had a customer hit a 500 when they used an older model.
maya: Good call. I'll add a short troubleshooting paragraph and test vectors.
julia: For the JS snippet, can we show both callback streaming and the promise-based streaming? Many of our examples only show Python sync.
maya: Yep. Draft JS snippet in the PR — keeping it minimal:
```
// JS SDK: prefetch + small-batch example
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'llama-prefetch-v1',
  input: 'Summarize the paragraph',
  prefetch: true,
  batch: { size: 8, max_concurrent_requests: 4 }
});
console.log(resp.output[0].text);
```
ben: Perfect. One nit: use `batch.size` in the narrative (we use dot notation elsewhere). Also add a short note about latency tradeoffs (larger batch -> lower unit cost, but increased tail latency).
ci-bot: build/docs-md-lint: failed — MD014 line-length. (3 files)
maya: Ugh, thanks CI. I wrapped the long lines in the PR. Re-triggering build.
ci-bot: build/docs-md-lint: passed on branch maya/prefetch-simplify.
arjun: Can we add a tiny regression test that runs the example through our sample-eval harness? That prevents future breakage when we rename fields.
maya: Adding a minimal test in tests/examples/test_prefetch.py — will push shortly.
julia: One more ask: add a short table showing recommended quant profiles for short vs long sequences (2 rows). Keep it prescriptive: `q8_0` for short, `q4_k_m` for long.
maya: Will add it but keep phrasing careful: "recommendations, not hard constraints".
ben: OK to merge when CI + test pass. I'll do a final pass on copy.
maya: Thanks all — merging after green. Will post a brief changelog blurb in #release-notes when done. :shipit:
